agent.reasons: The registry filing is dated 2026-02-24, so it is about 8 months old at the 2026-10-27 review. Section 3.5 requires it to be under 6 months old, so documents must be requested. Ownership is complete (Jia Kowalski 31% directly, Tara Quinlan 26% through Linden Holdings LLC), and the control person, Umar Weiss, is verified. Tara Quinlan has an adverse media flag, but the file has no source, matching identifiers, search terms, dates or sources reviewed, so section 4.4 materiality can't be shown and escalation isn't supported. That leaves an open item, which under 2.2 and 2.1 is outranked by the request for documents.
still_needed: A current registry filing for the entity, less than 6 months old

Details of Tara Quinlan's adverse media hit for the 4.4 materiality test: the source and its type, which identifiers match (name plus age, location or role), and a record of the search terms, date and sources reviewed
